component.name: SkeletonRows
component.script:
sub init_x() m.sk = m.top.findNode("sk") m.pulse = m.top.findNode("pulse") build() m.pulse.control = "start" end sub sub init() try init_x() catch e reportCrash("SkeletonRows.init", e) end try end sub
sub build_x() while m.sk.getChildCount() > 0 m.sk.removeChildIndex(0) end while w = m.top.itemWidth h = m.top.itemHeight for r = 0 to m.top.rows - 1 y = r * (h + 90) bar = m.sk.createChild("Rectangle") bar.translation = [0, y] bar.width = 320 bar.height = 26 bar.color = "0x2A2D36FF" for i = 0 to 8 rc = m.sk.createChild("Rectangle") rc.translation = [i * (w + 20), y + 44] rc.width = w rc.height = h rc.color = "0x23262FFF" end for end for end sub sub build() try build_x() catch e reportCrash("SkeletonRows.build", e) end try end sub
sub onActive_x() if m.top.active m.pulse.control = "start" else m.pulse.control = "stop" end if end sub sub onActive() try onActive_x() catch e reportCrash("SkeletonRows.onActive", e) end try end sub
